hypothesis: The differing e843419 load veneers contribute the observed B-minus-A TTFT increase, independently of host address layout.
scope: diagnosis only; no performance acceptance or deployment

variants.A1: main with six proven load veneers inlined at original sites
variants.B1: HC with five proven load veneers inlined at original sites

instrumentation: Q4T_LAYER_TIMING=1 only; no Nsight, no LD_PRELOAD probe
lease: one gpu_exclusive invocation holds the lease across all eight requests
negative_control: Within each variant, the two runs have identical executable/input identities; the second four-run block reverses order.
report: for each block g0=B0-A0, g1=B1-A1, dA=A0-A1, dB=B0-B1, interaction=dB-dA=g0-g1
prefill event group deltas, not interpreted as pure GPU busy
mechanistic_support_rule: Both blocks must have g0>0, interaction>R and abs(g1)<=R to support a repeatable, resolved veneer contribution. This is a conservative diagnostic criterion, not a significance or performance acceptance test.
otherwise: Mark veneer causality unresolved at this resolution; do not declare noise, equivalence, a proven no-effect, or permission to accept HC.
stop_rules: Any guard ENV_ABORT: stop and retain all evidence, no automatic retry
Any input/output/capacity/error mismatch: stop and retain evidence
No extra warmup, connection probe, alternate link layout, or added samples
